constraints: Vertical alignment can be applied to the following form objects: list boxes, list box columns, list box headers and footers.

params.name: alignment
params.description: Alignment code, a constant from the Form Objects (Properties) theme.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Modifies the vertical alignment of the form object(s) designated by object to the alignment constant passed in alignment.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by '*'; added the documented alignment constant sentinel values.
